## Usage

Install once in R:

```{r}
#| eval: false
install.packages(c("rstac", "sf", "httr", "jsonlite", "knitr", "rmarkdown"))
```

Save the polygon as `aoi.geojson` next to this Quarto file, or change
`polygon` to the path of a GeoPackage or shapefile with a defined CRS. If the
file does not exist, an example AOI near Mendoza, Argentina, is used.
If there are several polygons, the search uses their union. Dates are inclusive, in UTC.

1. Change the polygon and the dates in `params`, keeping `ids: ""`, and render.
2. Check the table and the plot. Copy the chosen **product_id**.
3. Change, for example, `ids: "LC09_L2SP_224085_20240130_20240131_02_T1"`
   and render again. Several IDs from the table can be included, separated by commas.

The search is public. The download needs an ERS account with M2M access
enabled and an **application token**, not the password or a browser session.
Set `USGS_USERNAME` and `USGS_TOKEN` as environment variables, for example
in the project's `.Renviron` file, and restart R. Do not publish that file.
The code reads these variables without showing them in the report.

```text
USGS_USERNAME= your_username
USGS_TOKEN= your_application_token
```

From a terminal with R and Quarto available:

```bash
quarto render vignettes/Landsat_download_USGS.qmd
```

Complete scenes are downloaded, without cropping or reprojecting. Each product is
stored in `<dest>/<product_id>/` (parameter `dest`), with the TAR and all its
extracted files, including `*_MTL.txt`, keeping their original names. If the
product folder already exists, the process stops to avoid overwriting data.

For more information on the L8/L9 scenes and their processing, see:
https://www.usgs.gov/landsat-missions/landsat-collection-2-level-2-science-products
https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/science/usgs-eros-archive-landsat-archives-landsat-8-9-olitirs-collection-2-level-2


## Search scenes

```{r}
library(rstac)
library(sf)

from <- as.Date(params$from)
to <- as.Date(params$to)
stopifnot(!is.na(from), !is.na(to), from <= to)

if (file.exists(params$polygon)) {
  aoi <- st_read(params$polygon, quiet = TRUE)
} else {
  # No polygon file: example AOI in Mendoza (UTM 19, EPSG:32619)
  bbox_coords <- c(xmin = 500000, ymin = -3660000, xmax = 526000, ymax = -3644000)
  aoi <- st_as_sf(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(bbox_coords)), crs = 32619)
}


if (nrow(aoi) == 0L || is.na(st_crs(aoi))) stop("Empty polygon or no CRS.")
if (!all(st_geometry_type(aoi) %in% c("POLYGON", "MULTIPOLYGON"))) {
  stop("The file must contain only polygons.")
}
aoi <- st_union(st_transform(st_make_valid(aoi), 4326))
if (any(st_is_empty(aoi)) || !all(st_is_valid(aoi))) stop("Invalid geometry.")

datetime = paste0(
  format(as.Date(from), "%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00Z"), "/",
  format(as.Date(to), "%Y-%m-%dT23:59:59Z")
)

items <- stac("https://landsatlook.usgs.gov/stac-server") |>
  stac_search(
    collections = c("landsat-c2l1", "landsat-c2l2-sr", "landsat-c2l2-st"),
    bbox = as.vector(st_bbox(st_transform(aoi, 4326))),
    datetime = datetime,
    limit = 100
  ) |>
  post_request() |>
  items_fetch()


scenes <- Filter(function(x) grepl("^LC0[89]_", x$id) &&
                   as.Date(substr(x$properties$datetime, 1, 10)) <= to,
                 items$features)
if (!length(scenes)) stop("No Landsat 8/9 scenes for this polygon and dates.")

scene_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(scenes, function(x) {
  clouds <- x$properties[["eo:cloud_cover"]]
  if (is.null(clouds) || clouds < 0 || clouds > 100) clouds <- NA_real_
  data.frame(
    product_id = sub("_(SR|ST)$", "", x$id),
    date = substr(x$properties$datetime, 1, 10),
    satellite = x$properties$platform,
    level = if (x$collection == "landsat-c2l1") "L1" else "L2",
    cloud_pct = clouds
  )
}))

scene_table <- scene_table[!duplicated(scene_table$product_id), ]
scene_table <- scene_table[order(scene_table$date, scene_table$level, scene_table$product_id), ]
rownames(scene_table) <- NULL
dir.create(params$dest, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(scene_table, file.path(params$dest, "scenes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(scene_table, digits = 2)
```

## Cloud cover

`eo:cloud_cover` is the cloud percentage of the **whole scene**, not of the
polygon. L1 and L2 of the same acquisition can have the same cloud cover.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
valid <- !is.na(scene_table$cloud_pct)
if (any(valid)) {
  colors <- ifelse(scene_table$level == "L1", "#0072B2", "#D55E00")
  plot(as.Date(scene_table$date[valid]), scene_table$cloud_pct[valid],
       col = colors[valid], pch = 19, ylim = c(0, 100),
       xlab = "Acquisition date", ylab = "Scene cloud cover (%)")
  text(as.Date(scene_table$date[valid]), scene_table$cloud_pct[valid],
       labels = which(valid), pos = 3, cex = 0.7)
  legend("topright", c("L1", "L2"), col = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"), pch = 19)
} else {
  cat("The scenes do not report valid cloud cover.")
}
```

The numbers above the points are the rows of the table and of the CSV file.
Some points can overlap.

## Download the chosen products

STAC separates reflectance (`SR`) and temperature (`ST`) in level 2. Here the
USGS **Product Bundle** is downloaded: it includes all the files of the L1 or
L2 product, not only the bands of one STAC collection. L2SR has no surface
temperature; L2SP includes the available temperature files.

```{r}
#| echo: false
m2m <- function(endpoint, body = list(), key = NULL) {
  headers <- if (is.null(key)) character() else c("X-Auth-Token" = key)
  r <- httr::POST(
    paste0("https://m2m.cr.usgs.gov/api/api/json/stable/", endpoint),
    httr::add_headers(.headers = headers),
    body = body, encode = "json", httr::timeout(120)
  )
  x <- tryCatch(httr::content(r, as = "parsed", simplifyVector = FALSE),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.list(x) && !is.null(x$errorCode)) {
    stop(endpoint, " (HTTP ", httr::status_code(r), "): ",
         x$errorCode, " - ", x$errorMessage, call. = FALSE)
  }
  httr::stop_for_status(r, task = endpoint)
  x$data
}

download_product <- function(id, dest, key) {
  level <- if (grepl("_L1", id, fixed = TRUE)) "l1" else "l2"
  dataset <- paste0("landsat_ot_c2_", level)
  folder <- file.path(dest, id)
  if (file.exists(folder)) stop("Already exists: ", folder)
  scene_list <- paste0("quarto_", Sys.getpid(), "_", basename(tempfile()))
  on.exit(try(m2m("scene-list-remove", list(listId = scene_list), key), silent = TRUE))
  m2m("scene-list-add", list(listId = scene_list, datasetName = dataset,
                             idField = "displayId", entityIds = list(id)), key)
  options <- m2m("download-options", list(datasetName = dataset, listId = scene_list), key)
  bundle <- Filter(function(x) isTRUE(x$available) &&
                     grepl("Product Bundle", x$productName, ignore.case = TRUE), options)
  if (length(bundle) != 1L) stop("There is not exactly one Product Bundle available for ", id)

  label <- paste0(scene_list, "_download")
  request <- m2m("download-request", list(label = label, downloads = list(
    list(entityId = bundle[[1]]$entityId, productId = bundle[[1]]$id))), key)
  links <- request$availableDownloads
  # shortcut: waits up to 10 minutes; increase it if USGS needs longer to prepare the files.
  for (attempt in seq_len(40)) {
    if (length(links)) break
    if (!length(request$preparingDownloads)) stop("USGS neither delivered nor started preparing the download.")
    Sys.sleep(15)
    status <- m2m("download-retrieve", list(label = label), key)
    links <- c(status$available, status$requested)
    links <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x$url) && nzchar(x$url), links)
  }
  if (length(links) != 1L) stop("Download not available yet or ambiguous response: ", id)

  tmp <- tempfile(pattern = ".landsat_", tmpdir = dest)
  dir.create(tmp)
  on.exit(unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  partial <- file.path(tmp, "bundle.part")
  r <- httr::GET(links[[1]]$url, httr::write_disk(partial), httr::timeout(3600))
  httr::stop_for_status(r)
  header <- httr::headers(r)[["content-disposition"]]
  pattern <- 'filename="?([^";]+)'
  name <- if (!is.null(header) && grepl(pattern, header)) {
    trimws(sub(paste0(".*", pattern, ".*"), "\\1", header))
  } else paste0(id, ".tar")
  if (basename(name) != name || grepl("[\\\\/]", name) ||
      !grepl("\\.tar(\\.gz)?$", name)) stop("Unexpected name of the USGS package.")

  files <- utils::untar(partial, list = TRUE)
  if (!length(files) || any(grepl("(^[/\\\\]|^[A-Za-z]:|(^|[/\\\\])\\.\\.([/\\\\]|$))", files))) {
    stop("Empty package or invalid extraction paths.")
  }
  if (!any(grepl("_MTL\\.txt$", files))) stop("The package does not contain MTL.txt.")
  if (utils::untar(partial, exdir = tmp) != 0L) stop("Extraction failed: ", id)
  paths <- file.path(tmp, files)
  if (!all(file.exists(paths)) || any(file.info(paths)$size == 0 & !dir.exists(paths))) {
    stop("Missing or empty files: ", id)
  }
  if (!file.rename(partial, file.path(tmp, name))) stop("The TAR could not be saved.")
  if (!file.rename(tmp, folder)) stop("The product could not be saved.")
  cat("Downloaded:", id, "-", length(files), "entries in the package.\n")
}

ids <- unique(trimws(strsplit(params$ids, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]))
ids <- ids[nzchar(ids)]
if (length(ids)) {
  if (!all(ids %in% scene_table$product_id)) stop("Choose IDs from the table of this search.")
  username <- Sys.getenv("USGS_USERNAME")
  token <- Sys.getenv("USGS_TOKEN")
  if (!nzchar(username) || !nzchar(token)) stop("Set USGS_USERNAME and USGS_TOKEN.")
  key <- m2m("login-token", list(username = username, token = token))
  tryCatch({
    for (id in ids) download_product(id, params$dest, key)
  }, finally = try(m2m("logout", key = key), silent = TRUE))
} else {
  cat("Search only. To download, fill params$ids with IDs from the table.")
}


```
